title: Every Tracy mail ends Terms · Privacy · tracy.ai, the whitelist mails carry the Did not request this? box, the site invitation drops Manage notifications, and a signed-out /?settings=notifications keeps its destination through /login
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL unset, run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/mail-footer-terms.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/notification-mail.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/whitelist-confirmation-i18n.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# pass' and '# fail' lines and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: The sign-in mail's footer reads 'Terms · Privacy · tracy.ai' with links to https://tracy.ai/terms and https://tracy.ai/privacy, tracy.ai itself unlinked, and its text part ends 'Terms: https://tracy.ai/terms · Privacy: https://tracy.ai/privacy'; in Vietnamese the footer reads 'Điều khoản · Quyền riêng tư · tracy.ai'.
A notification letter's footer reads 'Manage notifications · Terms · Privacy · tracy.ai', translated in the reader's language with no {{marker}} left.

The whitelist invitation's subject is 'About your Tracy sign-in' and both of its variants carry the 'Did not request this? You can safely ignore this email.' box after the JoomlArt member box, in HTML and in the text part.
The whitelist confirmation ends with the same box and no longer says "Didn't ask to join?".

A signed-out GET /?settings=notifications redirects to /login?next=%2F%3Fsettings%3Dnotifications, also where a guest landing exists; / stays /login and /?utm_source=joomlart stays /login?utm_source=joomlart; all four /login forms carry that next.
evidence: Spec tracy-marketing/content/email/transactional/tracy-access/spec-2026-10-06 (Sarah, 06/10/2026): the whitelist mail landed in Gmail Promotions; on cowork.tracy.site a signed-out click on Manage notifications ended on the site with Settings closed. mail-footer-terms.test.mjs is 0/7 on origin/develop c0f766e94.
fence: Pure mail renderers and the root workspace door mounted alone; no mail provider, no Gmail, no Postgres.

tests: 1: the sign-in mail ends Terms · Privacy · tracy.ai
1: a notification letter keeps Manage notifications first
1: the sign-in mail in Vietnamese reads
2: the whitelist invitation is about the sign-in
3: the whitelist confirmation ends with the same box
5: a signed-out /?settings=notifications keeps where it was going in next
5: every way through /login keeps that next
the footer is one line: Manage notifications · Terms · Privacy · tracy.ai
the English mail kept its words
